entries.name: SRS session
entries.doesNotDo: It builds nothing you can use in a sentence. Cards make words retrievable in isolation, and the rest of the app exists because that is not the same as knowing them.

entries.name: Audio cards, operable blind
entries.trains: retention while your eyes are elsewhere
entries.doesNotDo: It cannot grade itself honestly. Marking your own spoken answer while walking is the loosest grading in the app, and the schedule inherits that noise.

entries.name: Mining sentences from your own content
entries.doesNotDo: It ignores frequency. Words you happen to meet are not the words that unlock the most text, and mining alone will leave common ones unlearned for years.

entries.name: Collocation cards rather than single words
entries.trains: fluency — the word with what it goes with
entries.doesNotDo: It counts as one item what is really several. A collocation card grows vocabulary size more slowly than the same minutes on single words.

entries.name: Closing a frequency block deliberately
entries.doesNotDo: It optimises the number rather than the need. Finishing a block is satisfying and it can spend a week on words you would never have missed.

entries.name: Handwriting sheet of the twenty shakiest cards
entries.doesNotDo: It is slow and it is off-app, so its result has to be typed back in or it produces no signal at all.
